notes.title: Technical Update
notes.content:
- Friends+ mode now increases the maximum number of friends to 100, unlocks access to message history, and raises the daily gem-sending limit.
- Hall of Fame filtering by language now lets you filter the list of Hall of Fame members by the language they use in-game.
- The historical ranking of Hall of Fame members will display the order in which players reached the Hall of Fame.
- A new card volume (#9) featuring exclusively female characters.
